# Architecture ladder 2 - results record (2026-09-11)

Common recipe: TabICLv2 prior, 20k steps, batch 4, lr 5e-4, emb 256 / 6 layers, rows 128-1024, cell budget 65536; E9 = 147 real datasets, K_FEAT 64 / CTX 1024, exact two-sided sign test per dataset.

| model | role | structure |
|---|---|---|
| `PFN_tabicl2_ds_s0` | baseline | encoder + bar head, value loss only (no latent term) |
| `TabularJEPA_v3_tabicl2_s0` | reference (collapsed) | encoder -> predictor(4) -> bar head ON the predictor; EMA diff latent target |
| `TabularJEPA_v3_tabicl2_s0_snap9250` | reference (v3 best snapshot, 9250) | same as v3 |
| `TabularJEPA_v3_tabicl2_headenc_s0` | run 1 | v3 with the bar head moved onto the ENCODER output; predictor latent-only; EMA diff target |
| `TabularJEPA_v3_tabicl2_dae_headenc_s0` | run 2 | headenc + EMA copy replaced by a denoising y-encoder (sigma .5, own bar-CE reconstruction), embedding = target |
| `TabularJEPA_v3_tabicl2_sigreg_headenc_s0` | run 3 | headenc + EMA copy replaced by LeWM SIGReg (same encoder full pass -> projector, no detach, additive lambda .05) |
| `v4_dual_split_ctx_tw4_diff_lam1_lr5e-4_mixed_cell_s0` | reference (real-prior dual_split 20k) | previous best JEPA run, real-data-matched prior |
